description.text: Objectives The Master of Science program in Applied Mathematics is designed for people who wish to work independently in teaching and research in math related fields. The program provides solid theory and systematic research skills in the areas of applied mathematics. We encourage our students to be systematic, professionally ethical, and internationally competent. Duration Duration of program is 2 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Differential Equations Theory and Application 2. Numerical Analysis and Scientific Computing 3. Time Series Analysis 4. Financial Mathematics Credit Units Students need to successfully complete minimum 32 credits.

duration.text: The Applied Mathematics at Harbin Institute of Technology(Shenzhen Campus) is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1) A copy of passport (the original passport will be checked during registration) 2) One passport-size photo (35mm*50mm) 3) Graduation certificate or Bachelor’s Degree 4) Bachelor’s Degree Transcript 5) Study Plan in Harbin Institute of Technology(Shenzhen Campus) 6) Two letters of recommendation from two associate professors or higher

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. 2. Be Healthy. 3. Under the age of 35. 4. Have attained a Bachelor's diploma with good marks. 5. Have solid financial support to afford the study and living expense in China. 6. Good English reading, writing and speaking skills.
